TMM
Description
iRule commands related to the Traffic Management Microkernel (TMM).
Command List
TMM::cmp_count
- Provides the active
number of TMM instances running.
TMM::cmp_group
- Returns the number
(0-x) of the group of the CPU executing the rule. Typically a
group refers to the blade number on a chassis system. and is
always 0 on other platforms.
TMM::cmp_primary_group
- returns
the CMP cluster primary
TMM::cmp_unit
- Returns the number (0-x)
of the CPU executing the rule.
